# Quotation response -- SOLMU-RFQ-2026-14

## Visakoivu Oy

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds electrical contracting rights at class S1, exceeding the required class S2 for this procurement. Our revenue for the most recent financial year was EUR 20,300,000, well above the required minimum of EUR 5,000,000. Our liability insurance and reference project history meet the requirements of Section 3, including reference contracts completed for private clients such as Haavikkoranta Oy and Pihlajisto Kiinteistot Oy within the past five years.

### Technical response

Condition data is collected during scheduled visits and reviewed for trend analysis. Continuity of service is maintained through team-based staffing with documented handover procedures. Waste generated on site is sorted in accordance with the site waste plan. Installed equipment carries our standard warranty. Periodic inspection of electrical installations is carried out in accordance with the statutory schedule. Field staff hold the qualifications required for work of this kind, consistent with our NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system. Spare parts availability and lead times are confirmed prior to each assignment. The content and scheduling of service visits is agreed with the client in advance. Emergency response to fault reports is provided within 4 hours of notification, as required under Section 4.10.

### Commercial terms

The contract period and extension option are accepted as set out in Section 5. A cost breakdown is provided as required.

### Forms

Trade register extract and tax payment certificate are enclosed.

### Quotation format

Submitted as a single PDF without password protection. Price stated as EUR/m2/year. This response is within the 20-page limit. Framework pricing is quoted in EUR.

### Annex A -- additional technical requirements

The building envelope is inspected periodically and findings reported to centre management. A documented safety plan governs all work under this contract. Elevator servicing is carried out in conformity with the applicable regulatory requirements.

### Annex B -- commercial and forms

In accordance with the technical cross-reference at Annex B, Section 1.1, the response time for this contract is 2 hours from notification. A volume discount structure applies under the framework. Insurance certificate and key personnel CVs are enclosed.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to submit this quotation.
